intent: Small real fix, dogfooding the merge pipeline (#1406). In your worktree: (1) in packages/framework/prompts/todo_format.md fix the typo priortiy -> priority. (2) From packages/framework run node scripts/gen-prompts.mjs so src/prompts.generated.ts regenerates, and verify with git diff that only those two files changed. (3) Commit both files with a one-line message mentioning the typo fix. No SPEC.md changes are needed for a typo in prose. Then call setReadyForMerge() — the merge handoff is armed and the PR must wait for CI, which is exactly what this dogfood verifies.
